description: Prices at one bookmaker that sit above a fair-odds estimate from market consensus, with expectedValue, betSide, the bookmaker's odds and bet link. Prematch, refreshed every few seconds. Filter by sport and league and use maxResults to keep the list short. expectedValue is bookmaker/fair x 100; edge % = expectedValue - 100 (103.42 is a 3.42% edge, below 100 is a negative edge). Never multiply it by 100. Expected value is an estimate, not a guaranteed outcome.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated top-level fields to keep on each item (e.g. 'id,home,away,date,status'). Trims large responses.

includeEventDetails.description: Include teams, date, sport and league for each row

league.description: League slug from get_leagues. Requires sport

maxResults.description: Optional cap on the number of items returned to you (applied after the API call).

name: get_value_bets
